# The installer scripts of cjw_multisite

`cjw_multisite` builds its site with two PHP files in `settings/` of the package: `cjw-multi-site-installer.php`
(the class `cjwMultiSiteInstaller`, 5,939 lines) and `cjw-starter-install.php` (the starter content functions, 827
lines), with `post-install-fix.php` (593 lines) as a helper. This page follows an install through them in order. It
is for developers who change the installer or write one like it; administrators reading a setup log find here what
each step's notice means.

The file's header says where it comes from: "Generated from the 7x MultiSite installer (sevenx_multisite,
sevenx-multi-site-installer.php) for the starter site of the cjw_themes_jumper extension". Most steps are therefore
the same as in [The multisite installer script](../sevenx-multisite/the-multisite-installer-script.md); this page
dwells on what is different.

## When the setup calls what

The create sites step of the setup (`kernel/setup/steps/ezstep_create_sites.php`) loads the settings files of the
site package and calls the functions they define, in this order:

| Order | Function (settings file) | Installer method |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `eZSitePreInstall()` (`install-scripts.php`) | `preInstall()` |
| 2 | the kernel installs the required packages (`$package->install()`) | none |
| 3 | `eZSiteINISettings()`, `eZSiteAdminINISettings()`, `eZSiteCommonINISettings()` | `siteINISettings()`, `adminINISettings()`, `commonINISettings()` |
| 4 | `eZSiteRoles()` (`roles.php`) | `siteRoles()` |
| 5 | `eZSitePreferences()` (`preferences.php`) | `sitePreferences()` |
| 6 | `eZSitePostInstall( &$parameters )` (`install-scripts.php`) | `postInstall()`, which runs the steps of `initSteps()` |

The kernel's `eZSiteInstaller::executeSteps()` runs the post-install steps one after the other and stops the chain at
the first step that reports an error, so the installer puts robust repairs early and cosmetic steps last.

## The settings the installer starts from

`initSettings()` reads the parameters of the setup and fixes these values:

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| `main_site_design` | `starter` |
| `user_siteaccess` | the setup's choice, `site` when empty |
| `admin_siteaccess`, `editor_siteaccess` | the setup's choice (`admin` when empty), `editor` |
| `adminui_siteaccess` | `adminui` when the `exp_adminui` extension is there and the kernel can make it, else empty |
| `site_title` | the typed title; `CJW JAC Exponential` when it is empty, the package summary, `CJW Multisite` or `Exponential` |
| `extension_list` | the `ActiveExtensions[]` list: the same list as `sevenx_multisite` plus `cjw_themes_jumper` and `cjw_tmv`; `cjw_tmv` is dropped when `extension/cjw_tmv` is missing |
| `language_siteaccess_map` | one translation siteaccess per further language (see [Siteaccesses and languages](siteaccesses-and-languages.md)) |
| `fallback_locales` | `eng-US` when the chosen languages lack it, unless the setup passes its own `fallback_language_codes` |
| `var_dir` | `var/site` |

## Before the packages: preInstall()

1. Records the highest node id and object id of the base data (`cjwBaseMaxNodeID`, `cjwBaseMaxObjectID`), so the
   later node fix can tell base data from package content.
2. Adds the attributes `tags` (`ezkeyword`) and `publish_date` (`ezdatetime`) to the class `folder`, named in the
   site's primary language.
3. Sets `[FileSettings] VarDir=var/site` for the run and prepends the `settings/` folder of every extension in the
   list (`activateSiteExtensionSettings()`), so datatypes such as those of enhancedselection2 and eztags are known while
   classes and objects are imported.
4. Links the starter content's images and files from `extension/cjw_themes_jumper/share/` into the content package
   (`cjwLinkStarterFilesFromExtension()`).
5. Registers the datatypes `ezsrrating`, `ezgmaplocation`, `ngenhancedlink` and `eztags` for the run.
6. Adds the two-step sign-in field to the user class when `sevenx_authentication_2fa` is available.
7. Drops and recreates the tables of every extension schema (`dropExtensionTables()`, `insertDBFile()`): the named
   ones (`ezstarrating`, `ezgmaplocation`, `eztags`, `explayouts`, `enhancedselection2`, `cjw_newsletter`,
   `syndication`) plus every other listed extension with a `share/db_schema.dba` or `sql/<engine>/schema.sql`, and
   the admin access extensions. **Tables only**: no `db_data.dba` is loaded (`declaredExtensionSchemas()` passes
   `false` for every entry).
8. Repairs the language columns of eztags rows from the base data when `eng-GB` exists.

## INI settings, roles and preferences

| Method | Writes |
|---|---|
| `siteINISettings()` | `settings/siteaccess/<site>/`: menu, override, toolbar, `site.ini` (locale, `SiteLanguageList`, `LoginPage=embedded`, one session across the public siteaccesses), image, content, template, content structure menu, ODF |
| `adminINISettings()` | `settings/siteaccess/<admin>/`: login required, `ShowHiddenNodes=true`, `TranslationSA`, `ActiveAccessExtensions[]` (`expai`, `exp_adminui` where present), menus, toolbar, overrides, icons |
| `commonINISettings()` | `settings/override/`: `AvailableSiteAccessList`, `SiteList`, `DefaultAccess`, `MatchOrder` (`uri;host`, or `uri;port` for port access), `ForceVirtualHost=true`, `ActiveExtensions[]`, the database settings of the chosen driver, cache headers for anonymous visitors (`public, max-age=300`) and more |
| `siteRoles()` | policies for Anonymous and Member (rss feed, `user/login` on every served siteaccess except `admin` and `adminui`, `content/read` in section 3, `tags/view`, `info-collection/read`, `osm_proxy/tiles`) and the `user2fa` policies when two-step sign-in is available |
| `sitePreferences()` | the administrator's admin panel preferences |

The `osm_proxy/tiles` policy is specific to this package: the maps of the starter design load their tiles through the
`osm_proxy` module of `cjw_themes_jumper`.

## After the packages: the post-install steps

The steps of `initSteps()`, in order, grouped:

| Steps | What they do |
|---|---|
| `postInstallFixContentObjectNameLanguages`, `postInstallResolveRelationListIds`, `postInstallImportNewsletterClasses` | Repairs of the imported data; the newsletter classes of `cjw_newsletter` |
| `postInstallAdminSiteaccessINIUpdate` | Admin design `admin4l` with `admin4`, `admin3`, `admin2`, `admin` after it; `RootNode=2` |
| `postInstallUserSiteaccessINIUpdate` | The user siteaccess: `SiteDesign=starter`, `AdditionalSiteDesignList[]=standard`, `ExtensionSettingsSiteAccess=cjw_starter`, start page, starter root, `PathPrefix`, `TranslationSA`; the override blocks of other extensions for a siteaccess of this name are taken out of use |
| `createTranslationSiteAccesses`, `createSecondarySiteaccesses` | One siteaccess per further language; no secondary siteaccesses |
| template look, swap and remove steps, `createContentSection` (Restricted), role policies, user groups (Partners, Members), role assignments, folder attribute names | As in the 7x installer |
| `setRSSExport` | The feed `my_feed` ("My RSS Feed") of `ng_article` objects below the starter root |
| `postInstallFixPackageNodesAndExplayouts` | Maps package node and object ids to the installed ones (`cjwFixPackageNodesAndExplayouts()`) |
| `postInstallStarterContent` | The starter content steps below |
| `postInstallImportAdminLayouts` | The admin layouts from `explayouts/share/fragments/admin_layouts_db_data.dba`, ids from 100001 on, once |
| `postInstallRegenerateURLAliases`, `postInstallCreateSitePrefixAliases`, `postInstallStarterPaths` | URL aliases, then the starter's own paths from `cjw-paths.json` |
| `postInstallClearLinksToContentNotInstalled` | Title block links to sections that are not installed are switched off |
| `postInstallPlaceOrphanedPackageObjects` | Places objects the package install left without a node, under the parent named in their object file |
| `postInstallSetSiteHomeAndPrefix` | `IndexPage`, `RootNode`, `RootNodeDepth` and `PathPrefix` for the user siteaccess and its translations; menus copied to the translations |
| `postInstallStarterPolicyPages` | `menu.ini [SiteInfo] PrivacyPolicyID` and `CookiePolicyID` to the privacy page (`cjw-starter-n-809`) |
| `postInstallCloseInformationPagesOnPublicSiteaccesses` | The `ezinfo` module is switched off on the public siteaccesses |
| `postInstallResyncContentClassNames`, `postInstallRepairClassNameLists` | Class names keyed by a language |
| `postInstallCreateAdminUISiteaccess` | `settings/siteaccess/adminui` from the admin's files |
| `postInstallEnableSearchStatsOnEverySiteaccess` | `LogSearchStats=enabled` |
| `postInstallWriteMultisiteURLSettings` | `settings/override/ezurlmultisite.ini.append.php` |
| two `updateObjectAttributeFromString` steps | The logo and the site style on the template look object, deliberately last |

## The starter content steps

`cjwInstallStarterContent( $siteaccesses )` runs as the administrator (user 14) and calls, in order:

| Part | Function | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| class additions | `cjwEnsureStarterClassAdditions()` | Missing attributes from `cjw-class-additions.xml` |
| rich text references | `cjwPostUnserializeStarterObjects()` | `eZContentObject::postUnserialize()` for every starter object, which the handler skips for remote ids that are not 32 characters long |
| links | `cjwResolveStarterLinks()` | `ngenhancedlink` values get the target's object id |
| tags | `cjwFixStarterTags()` | The tag "Starter" and its tags, linked to the eztags fields |
| dates | `cjwRestoreStarterDates()` | Publish and modify times from the package |
| hidden folder | `cjwHideStarterNodes()` | Hides `cjw-starter-n-807` |
| layouts | `cjwSeedStarterLayouts()` | The rows of `cjw-explayouts.json`, band 900000 |
| file links removed | `cjwUnlinkStarterFilesFromExtension()` | Removes the links made before the install |

Each part logs its result; a failed part is named in one error line, and the install carries on. All content caches
are cleared at the end.

## Reading the log

Notices to look for in the debug output of the install:

```text
Base data before the content package: nodes up to ..., objects up to ...; content package cjw_multisite_democontent
Starter content files from the extension: <n> linked, <n> copied, <n> missing
Class additions of the starter content: <n> added, <n> present
Starter layouts: <n> rows in 10 tables, rules for <the user siteaccesses>
Starter paths: <n> renamed, <n> differences left
```

> **Warning**
> "Files of the starter content not found in extension/cjw_themes_jumper/share" means the extension is missing or
> incomplete: the images of the site will be missing too. Put the extension in place and install again.
